history.content: Quick question: how many moves should my cross be?
{"answer":"Aim for eight moves or fewer, planned in inspection before you touch the cube.","refs":[{"kind":"pack","id":"cross-efficiency"}],"followUps":[]}
And what turning speed is normal for me?
{"answer":"At your level smooth beats fast. Turn at a pace where you never have to correct a slip.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
Should I drill OLL or PLL more?
{"answer":"Keep your normal practice on both and don't add new algorithm sets yet.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
How long should a practice session be?
{"answer":"Twenty to thirty focused minutes beats two hours of random solving.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
Is it okay to use my pinky for U moves?
{"answer":"Yes, if it lets you turn smoothly without regripping. Film yourself and look for wasted regrips.","refs":[{"kind":"pack","id":"turning-technique"}],"followUps":[]}
{"answer":"A little. Pick something you like once and stop changing it; it isn't what is holding you back.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
